Syneren has developed the Configurable Case Management Application Platform (CMAP) which is a powerful, no-code/low-code platform with AI/ML, that streamlines systems from request submission to approval with real-time insights, custom reports, and smart navigation tools for effortless control. 

It is a completely configurable Microservices architecture-based solution with a robust, secure and scalable software framework.

CMAP provides to the agencies an AI/ML, RPA chatbot integrated business process automation and low-code, no-code platform to deploy modernized applications at the speed of the mission. CMAP offers Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) functionality which empowers client organizations to seamlessly design, automate, track, analyze and report on their mission critical operations, while meeting with stringent FedRAMP security standards. CMAP significantly increases efficiency, productivity and fosters collaboration and transparency while reducing manual tasks. CMAP can be used to efficiently build, enhance and maintain applications in various use cases including law enforcement, finance, logistics, contracts, acquisitions, case management, human resources, IT Service Management, etc.
